mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 0.09% is at a historically low level, indicating an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the periods when UNRATE > 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of unemployment rate above 6.5% and employment growth below 10,000 persons per month signals a severe labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the periods when UNRATE > 6.5 AND PAYEMS < 145000.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 260), the central bank is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the periods when CPIAUCSL > 260.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1420 thousand units, it indicates weak consumer demand and a contracting housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the periods when HOUST < 1420.

mechanism_narrative: The current industrial production index (INDPRO) at 101.5055, above its 2017 base level of 100, indicates expanding industrial output, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: When residential sales (RSAFS) exceed 500,000 million dollars, it indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods when RSAFS > 500000.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) exceeds 18,000 billion dollars, it indicates robust economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods when GDPC1 > 18000.
